svg.aria-label: The plan mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Socratic mentor: given each answer, resumed or started fresh (agent); The mentor's question: each answer; offers after 8 rounds on a chapter and 30 in all (stop); Planner: the outline from the chapter summaries (agent); Mentor, Step 2.5: contribution sharpening, one round or more (agent); Planner: evaluates each stress-test answer (agent); Planner: the chapter plan (agent); The plan's handoff (stop).
